page.content:
The Deadman whose WrestleMania streak became company myth.

How The Undertaker connects

  • Event: WrestleMania — The Undertaker's WrestleMania streak became company myth.
  • Event: Survivor Series — The Undertaker debuted at Survivor Series 1990.

What is The Undertaker?

The Undertaker debuted at Survivor Series 1990 and built a two-decade WrestleMania winning streak, Ministry chapters, and American Badass runs that made him WWE's longest-running character.

Key threads lead to WrestleMania and Survivor Series.
